QuestInfo.name: Report to Muirhat
QuestInfo.parent: A Mysterious Presence On-board The Nautilus
QuestInfo.0: Baine discovers that the Black Mage's Disciples have been secretly observing The Nautilus. And with that discovery, Baine's report is now ready to be delivered to Muirhat. Baine wants me to bring the report to Muirhat myself, since I gave him so much help with writing the report...
QuestInfo.1: This report contains the Black Mage's Token which I found, plus a description of the strange sound waves that Baine had heard. It also includes information about the suspicious movements that Bart saw. I should take this to #bMuirhat#k.
QuestInfo.2: When Muirhat receives the report, he is surprised and shocked to find that the Black Mage's influence has spread as far as here.

1.0: Did you just say the spies from the Black Mage? What? They are here, all the way to The Nautilus...?

yes.0: Hmmm... If it is indeed as stated in the report, then this is a serious, serious issue...

npc.0: Muirhat should be standing in front of the Captain's Room.

lost.0: I can't believe you just lost that. I'll give you another copy of the report, as well as the token that someone else had picked up. Please don't lose them again.

0.0: Thanks to your help with the Black Mage's Token, I was able to complete the report much earlier than expected. I'll now have to give this report to Muirhat, but since you were the number one contributor with the Token and all, I think it's only fair that you hand in this report yourself. No?

yes.0: If things end up working out because of the report, then you may become the hero of The Nautilus. Please hand it in to #bMuirhat#k. Muirhat can be found #bin front of the Navigation Room#k on the #bupper hallways of The Nautilus#k.

no.0: He can seem like a man of very few words, and you may feel like he'd be unapproachable. In fact, the opposite is true, so I suggest you summon up the courage and talk to him. I mean, you'll also take the lion's share of the praises if this all goes well. You have nothing to lose!
